title: Jackson Ribs
description:
Grandma and Grandpa Jackson – Arlene and EZ – would often make these for the family when we were kids. We loved them then and we love them now – both the ribs and our parents!
In this preparation, the ribs are juicier and the sauce more flavorful than the typical dry-rubbed ribs.
They’re finger-lickin’ good!
ingredients: 2 slabs ribs, about 3-4 pounds each, cut up into individual rib sections
1 large can of pineapple chunks with sauce
directions: Gently simmer the ribs in water for about 30 minutes, to cook off much of the extra fat.
Meanwhile, add all the rest of the ingredients to a pot and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Put the ribs in a big oven pan and pour the sauce all around.
Serve and eat with plenty of napkins, maybe a fork, too, for the delicious chunky sauce!
